title: Eventual higher-direct-image vanishing for one coherent module with proper support
statement: Let S be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and f:X -> S locally of finite type. Let M be a coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent] with support proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. There exists N in the natural numbers such that R^p f_*M is zero for every natural p >= N. Here R^p f_* is the ordinary right derived functor of module direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image].

source.place: Tag 08E2, boundedness-above paragraph; Tag 08D5, uniform upper bound; Cohomology of Schemes, Tag 0CYS

proof.text: Local finite type over the locally Noetherian base makes X locally Noetherian. Convert coherence of M to quasi-coherence and finite type. The proper-support presentation gives a closed immersion i:Z -> X and a finite type quasi-coherent G with M isomorphic to i_*G and g=i followed by f proper. The degree-zero object is quasi-coherent by the generic qc_single helper in the module for [lem-sc-affine-derived-pushforward-t-exact], reused via import all; the geometric t-exactness theorem itself is not applied.

The closed immersion i is affine. Apply the affine derived-cohomology comparison to G[0]. Its derived image has cohomology only in degree zero, identified with i_*G. The standard heart equivalence therefore identifies Ri_*G[0] with M[0]. Derived direct-image composition identifies Rg_*G[0] with Rf_*M[0]. Use the single-object comparison with ordinary nonnegative right derived functors.

The proper morphism g is qcqs and S is quasi-compact. Apply the positive uniform derived-direct-image bound to G[0], whose cohomology is quasi-coherent and vanishes in positive degrees. Take N.toNat and transport zero cohomology through the preceding isomorphisms.

theorem moduleHigherDirectImage_eventually_isZero
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (hM : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace M)
    (hsupport : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f M) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ p : ℕ, N ≤ p →
      IsZero (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p).obj M)
